note: Scanned pages that the portal stores as images, not as a PDF file, so ElectronicFile.aspx returns an empty body. The portal's document viewer made this PDF on request (GeneratePDF10.aspx, then PDF10/<key>/<docid>), and every download has new bytes and a new hash: compare page images, not hashes. source_url is the record in the viewer.
